name: Medical Bed
instruction: Develop a 3D model of a medical bed. It should have adjustable head and foot sections, side rails for safety, and a simple control panel for adjusting the bed's position. The mattress should be flat and uniform.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a medical bed.
The bed features adjustable head and foot sections.
The mattress is flat and uniform.
The side rails are present for safety.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The head and foot sections are proportionate to the overall length of the bed.
The side rails are appropriately sized for safety without obstructing access.
Texture and surface detail: The bed frame has a smooth finish for easy cleaning.
The mattress may have a fabric texture suitable for comfort and hygiene.
The control panel has a simple, user-friendly interface.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The adjustable head and foot sections are correctly positioned relative to the mattress.
The side rails are securely attached and do not interfere with the bed's functionality.
The control panel is easily accessible from the side of the bed.
Object distance and contact: The mattress fits snugly within the bed frame.
There are no gaps between the mattress and the side rails.
The head and foot sections adjust without colliding with the side rails.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes are accurately represented in the model.
The adjustable features function as described.
The control panel is included and meets the simplicity requirement.
